app.name: SupportOne
app.tagline: Reads your computer, explains what it finds, changes nothing without asking.
agent.build.unsigned: This is an unsigned development build.
agent.checks.none: This build has no diagnostic checks compiled in yet.
agent.dry_run.active: Dry run: nothing on this computer will be changed.
agent.platform.unsupported: The SupportOne agent runs on Windows, macOS and Linux. This computer is not one of them.
check.unknown.tool_missing: Could not check: %s is not installed on this computer.
check.unknown.failed: This check could not finish, so there is no answer to report.
check.unknown.needs_admin: This check needs administrator rights to read what it reads.
check.os.info.ok: Running %s %s. It has been on for %s.
check.hardware.inventory.unreported: This computer does not report its make and model. It has a %s (%d cores).
check.hardware.ram.low: Only %s of memory. A current operating system and a few browser tabs will feel slow on this; more memory is the single biggest improvement you could make.
check.battery.health.absent: No battery — this is a desktop computer.
check.battery.health.ok: The battery is in good shape: it still holds %d%% of the charge it held when new.
check.battery.health.worn: The battery holds %d%% of the charge it held when new. It will not last as long away from a charger; plan to replace it.
check.battery.health.failing: The battery holds only %d%% of the charge it held when new and should be replaced.
check.battery.health.unreadable: There is a battery, but this computer does not report enough about it to judge its health.
check.disk.volumes.ok: %d drives checked. The one with the least room, %s, still has %s free.
check.disk.volumes.low: %s is running low on room: %s free (%s%%). Clearing space now avoids trouble later.
check.disk.volumes.critical: %s is nearly full: %s free (%s%%). At this level programs start failing to save files.
check.disk.volumes.none: No drives could be read on this computer.
check.disk.smart.ok.one: %d drive checked, and it reports itself healthy.
check.disk.smart.failing: The drive %s reports that it is failing. Back up your files now and plan to replace it.
check.disk.smart.bad_spots: The drive %s has %d bad spots it has had to stop using. It still works, but this is how a disk begins to fail: back up your files and keep an eye on it.
check.disk.smart.unknown: No drive would report its health. That is normal for USB drives and some laptops, and is not a sign of a problem.
check.disk.smart.no_disks: No drives were found to check.
check.network.config.ok: Connected on %s, through the router at %s.
check.network.config.no_address: This computer has no network address, so it is not connected to any network.
check.network.config.no_gateway: Connected on %s, but there is no route out to the internet. Other devices in the building may work; websites will not.
check.network.config.no_dns: Connected on %s, but no DNS server is set, so website names cannot be looked up.
check.network.config.interfaces_unreadab: The network connections could not be read.
check.drivers.problem.ok: Every device reports that it is working.
check.drivers.problem.not_applicable: This check only applies to Windows, which is where devices report an error state.
check.startup.items.ok: %d programs start on their own when you log in.
check.startup.items.ok.one: %d program starts on its own when you log in.
check.startup.items.none: Nothing is set to start on its own when you log in.
check.updates.os.ok: Updates were last installed %d days ago.
check.updates.os.pending: %d updates are waiting to be installed.
check.updates.os.pending.one: %d update is waiting to be installed.
check.updates.os.stale: Updates were last installed %d days ago, so security fixes released since then are missing.
check.updates.os.very_stale: Updates were last installed %d days ago. This computer is missing months of security fixes.
check.updates.os.unknown: This computer keeps no record of when it last installed updates.
check.security.posture.ok: Disk encryption, the firewall and antivirus all report as expected.
check.security.posture.no_encryption: The disk is not encrypted. If this computer is lost or stolen, the files on it can be read.
check.security.posture.no_antivirus: No antivirus is running on this computer.
check.security.posture.unreadable: None of the security settings could be read from this account.
check.eventlog.errors.none: The system recorded no errors about itself in the last %d days.
check.eventlog.errors.quiet: %d errors in the last %d days, none of them repeating. Every computer logs some; this is normal.
check.eventlog.errors.quiet.one: %d error in the last %d days, and nothing repeating. Every computer logs some; this is normal.
check.eventlog.errors.repeated: %s has failed %d times in the last %d days. Something there is going wrong over and over.
check.eventlog.errors.critical: %d serious system events in the last %d days, such as the computer restarting unexpectedly.
check.eventlog.errors.critical.one: %d serious system event in the last %d days, such as the computer restarting unexpectedly.
report.title: Computer health report
report.subtitle: What SupportOne read from this computer. It changed nothing.
report.no_findings: Nothing here needs your attention. That is a real result, not an empty page.
report.skipped_note: These checks need administrator rights and were not run. A check that did not run is not a check that passed.
report.about_body: Every line above was read from this computer; nothing was changed and nothing was sent anywhere. Checks that could not get an answer say so rather than reporting that all is well.
report.redacted: Identifying details have been removed from this copy at the request of the person who generated it.
ui.heading: Your computer's health
ui.subheading: SupportOne read this computer and changed nothing. Nothing leaves this machine unless you save or send it yourself.
ui.nothing_wrong: Nothing here needs your attention. That is a real result, not an empty page.
ui.skipped_note: These need administrator rights and were not run. A check that did not run is not a check that passed.
ui.redaction_note: The report is saved to this computer, not sent anywhere. Choose what to take out first, then see exactly what would be left.
ui.preview: Show exactly what would be saved
ui.preview_note: This is the whole file, as it would be written. Nothing else goes with it.
ui.closed: The session is closed and the agent has stopped. You can close this tab.
ui.offline_note: SupportOne made no internet connection while checking. Everything above was read on this computer and stays here unless you send it.
restore.unavailable.platform: This computer has no system restore point SupportOne can create. Each repair still carries its own undo.
restore.unavailable.disabled: System Restore is switched off on this computer. SupportOne will not switch it on for you.
restore.unavailable.needs_admin: Creating a restore point needs administrator rights, which SupportOne does not currently have.
restore.unavailable.unreadable: SupportOne could not tell whether a restore point can be created on this computer.
fix.outcome.dry_run: Dry run: this was described in full and nothing on this computer was changed.
fix.temp.clear.summary: Move old temporary files out of the way to free up space.
fix.temp.clear.undo: Everything is moved into a holding folder, not deleted. Undo puts every file back exactly where it was.
fix.temp.clear.change.move: Move temporary files untouched for more than a week into a SupportOne holding folder.
fix.temp.clear.change.keep: Leave anything newer than that exactly where it is.
fix.temp.clear.change.skip: Leave alone any file another program currently has open.
fix.temp.clear.blocked.nothing: There is nothing to clear: no temporary file here is old enough to move.
fix.temp.clear.blocked.unreadable: SupportOne could not read the temporary folder, so it will not guess at what is in it.
fix.temp.clear.outcome.moved: Moved %d files into the holding folder. Nothing was deleted.
fix.temp.clear.outcome.moved.one: Moved %d file into the holding folder. Nothing was deleted.
fix.temp.clear.outcome.in_use: Moved %d files into the holding folder. %d more are open in another program and were left alone.
fix.temp.clear.outcome.in_use.one: Moved %d file into the holding folder. %d more are open in another program and were left alone.
fix.net.flush_dns.summary: Clear the saved list of website addresses, so this computer looks them up fresh.
fix.net.flush_dns.undo: There is nothing to undo, and nothing is lost: this list is a copy of answers your computer will fetch again the moment it needs them.
fix.net.flush_dns.change.discard: Discard the addresses this computer has remembered for website names.
fix.net.flush_dns.change.refill: The list rebuilds itself the next time anything is looked up.
fix.net.flush_dns.blocked.no_tool: The tool this repair needs is not installed on this computer
fix.net.flush_dns.blocked.no_cache: This computer is not keeping a list of website addresses, so there is nothing to clear.
fix.net.flush_dns.blocked.platform: SupportOne has no way to clear this list on this operating system.
fix.net.flush_dns.outcome.cleared: The saved list of website addresses was cleared.
fix.print.clear_spooler.summary: Clear a stuck print queue so printing can start again.
fix.print.clear_spooler.undo: The queued documents are moved into a holding folder, not deleted. Undo puts the queue back exactly as it was.
fix.print.clear_spooler.change.stop: Stop the print service, so the queued files are no longer in use.
fix.print.clear_spooler.change.move: Move every queued document into a SupportOne holding folder.
fix.print.clear_spooler.blocked.empty: The print queue is already empty, so there is nothing stuck to clear.
fix.print.clear_spooler.blocked.unreadab: SupportOne could not read the print queue folder, so it will not guess at what is in it.
fix.print.clear_spooler.outcome.cleared: Moved %d queued documents into the holding folder and started the print service again.
Moved %d queued document into the holding folder and started the print service again.
wizard.outcome.fixed: Something was wrong, it was repaired, and checking again confirmed it.
wizard.outcome.unresolved: Something is still wrong. What was found, and what was tried, is listed below for whoever helps you next.
wizard.outcome.unverified: A change was made that this tool cannot check the effect of. Try the thing that was not working and see.
wizard.outcome.no_fault: Every question SupportOne knows how to ask came back clean. The problem is real; this tool cannot see the cause of it.
wizard.outcome.stopped: You ended this before it finished. Nothing further was changed.
wizard.step.applied: The change was made. Whether it helped is something only trying again can tell.
wizard.step.no_help: The repair was applied and the same problem is still here.
wizard.step.declined: You chose not to change this.
wizard.step.blocked: This could not be repaired from here.
wizard.connection.title: I can't get online
wizard.connection.complaint: This computer cannot reach the internet.
wizard.connection.step.link: Is this computer connected to a network?
wizard.connection.link.ok: Connected, with an address, on %d connections.
wizard.connection.link.none: No network connection is active on this computer.
wizard.connection.link.no_address: %d connections are active, but none of them was given a usable address.
wizard.connection.link.unreadable: SupportOne could not read this computer's network connections.
wizard.connection.link.advice: Check that Wi-Fi is switched on and joined to a network, or that the network cable is plugged in at both ends. If it is, restart the router and try again.
wizard.connection.step.config: Does this computer know where to send traffic?
wizard.connection.config.advice: This computer is connected but is missing the router address or the servers that look up website names. Restarting the router usually restores both. If it does not, this needs someone who can look at the network.
wizard.connection.step.cache: Is the saved list of website addresses worth clearing?
wizard.connection.cache.none: This computer is not keeping a saved list of website addresses, so there is nothing here to clear.
wizard.connection.cache.stale: This computer keeps a saved list of website addresses. If a website recently moved, the saved list can still point at the old place.
wizard.connection.cache.advice: Clearing this list is safe and costs nothing but a moment's delay on the next lookup. It is worth trying when one site fails and others work.
wizard.printing.title: It won't print
wizard.printing.service.stopped: The print service is not running, so nothing can print at all.
wizard.printing.service.unreadable: SupportOne could not read the state of the print service.
wizard.printing.service.advice: Starting the print service needs administrator rights, and SupportOne does not start services for you. Open Services, find Print Spooler, and start it — or ask whoever supports this computer to.
wizard.printing.step.queue: Is anything stuck in the print queue?
wizard.printing.queue.empty: The print queue is empty, so nothing is jammed.
wizard.printing.queue.stuck: %d documents are waiting in the print queue.
wizard.printing.queue.stuck.one: %d document is waiting in the print queue.
wizard.printing.queue.unreadable: SupportOne could not read the print queue folder.
wizard.printing.queue.advice: A document that will not finish printing blocks everything behind it. Clearing the queue moves the waiting documents aside; you can put them back if you need them.
wizard.printing.step.printer: Is a printer set as the default?
wizard.printing.printer.none: No printer is set as the default on this computer.
wizard.printing.printer.unreadable: SupportOne could not read which printer is set as the default.
wizard.printing.printer.advice: Open Printers and scanners, choose the printer you want, and set it as the default. If the printer you expect is not listed, it needs to be added first.
